Nesh-Deeka: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: this is one more step towards the Eye of Argonia at the Root; she does not know it, but the carving is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, a town on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, keep what is left of Kothringi lore; their elder will know. Then she says the Unbound have not been to the wreck: they lost the trail at Gideon. She sees the question coming, how she can know this, and answers it before it is asked: "We listen." She turns to Toklea and pays 100 gold. Does: sets stage 90.
100 gold added

*** Quest complete: The Pale Harvest ***
Journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make (the Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu long ago), and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

command: answer Notes: I killed the drowned sailor and Drowned Captain on the Pale Harvest, took the strongbox key and found a Kothringi Keystone (not the Eye). I gave it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. She paid 100 gold, so I have about 500 or more. I still carry the Old Silver Setting, The Collector note, the smuggler key and the Pale Harvest Strongbox Key. She does not know the keystone, but it is Kothringi (silver-skinned people, dead of the Knahaten Flu). The Chime-Keepers of Toklea, on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, keep Kothringi lore, and their elder should know. The Unbound lost the trail at Gideon and have not been to the wreck. She will not say how she knows; she only says "we listen". The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) also hunts the Eye. Next step: travel to Toklea and ask the Chime-Keepers about the keystone. I have not yet asked Nesh-Deeka the other topics.
